cd /app/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, random
rng=random.Random(99)
Q,L,U,R=16,8,2147483648,32
cuts=sorted(rng.sample(range(1,U),R-1))
borders=[0]+cuts+[U]
steps=[]; c=0; t=0
for i in range(40000):
    t+=1
    arr=[]
    n = 3 if i%10==0 else (0 if i%7==0 else 3)
    # keep total <= 120000
    for lane in range(min(L,n)):
        c+=1
        arr.append({"id":"s%06d"%c,"lane":lane,"rank":rng.randrange(U)})
    steps.append({"t":t,"serve":True,"arrivals":arr})
print("attempts", sum(len(s["arrivals"]) for s in steps))
json.dump({"mode":"stream","banks":Q,"lanes":L,"limit":U,"borders":borders,"capacity":20000,"epoch":997,"steps":steps}, open('big_stream.json','w'))
EOF
cd /app/work && /usr/bin/time -v python3 -I -B /app/submission/scheduler.py < big_burst.json > bb.out 2> bb.time; tail -20 bb.time; ls -la bb.out
